title: Bracket bench, assembled
note: The rig with a bracket bolted to the wall's face, reaching out from it, the reaching gauge arm on top and the hanger on the load bolt (bolts not drawn). Brackets are drawn as they print, standing on their back plate: turned a quarter about x, their back plate goes against the wall. Swap the bracket for bracket-web or bracket:printable.

fits.note: The bracket's back plate lies flat on the wall's face
fits.label: Bracket on wall

fits.note: The arm sits on the wall's top
fits.label: Arm on wall

fits.note: The hanger hangs beside the load boss
fits.label: Hanger by boss

fits.note: The arm clears the bracket as it bends
fits.label: Arm over bracket
